```{r}
library(lavaan)

set.seed(123)
```

```{r}
# @TODO Start writing intro/methods section

# Complex model structure + MSE objctive -> Optimized model works better
# Complex model structure + Likelihood objctive -> Lavaan model works better

# Simple model structure + MSE objctive -> Optimized model works better

# Define the SEM model
model <- '
    x1 ~ 1
    x2 ~ 1
    x3 ~ 1
    x4 ~ x1 + x2 + x3
'


# Define variable indices for predictors and outcome
x_names <- c(1, 2, 3)
y_names <- c(4)

# Generate synthetic data
data <- generate_sem_advantage_data(n = 100)

# Create a lavaan model object without fitting
zero_fit <- sem(model, data = data, do.fit = FALSE)

# Extract initial free parameters
free_params <- parTable(zero_fit)$est[parTable(zero_fit)$free > 0]

# Optimize the model using maximum likelihood
opt_result <- optim(
    par = free_params,
    fn = likelihood_sem,
    fit = zero_fit,
    data = data,
    x_names = x_names,
    y_names = y_names,
    method = "Nelder-Mead",
    hessian = TRUE
)
opt_result2 <- optim(
    par = free_params,
    fn = prediction_likelihood_sem,
    fit = zero_fit,
    data = data,
    x_names = x_names,
    y_names = y_names,
    method = "Nelder-Mead",
    hessian = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
# ------------------ HESSIAN ------------------
hessian_matrix <- opt_result$hessian
eigen_results <- eigen(hessian_matrix)
eigen_values <- eigen_results$values

# Check if all eigenvalues are positive (positive definite)
is_min <- all(eigen_values > 0)

# Condition number
cond_number <- max(eigen_values) / min(eigen_values)

# Standard errors of parameters
se <- try(sqrt(diag(solve(hessian_matrix))), silent = TRUE)
if(inherits(se, "try-error")) {
  se <- rep(NA, length(opt_result$par))
  warning("Hessian is singular, standard errors cannot be calculated")
}

# Print results
cat("Is a global minimum:", is_min, "\n")
cat("Condition number:", cond_number, "\n")
cat("Smallest eigenvalue:", min(eigen_values), "\n")
cat("Largest eigenvalue:", max(eigen_values), "\n")
```

```{r}
x_names <- c(1, 2, 3)
y_names <- c(4)
#data <- generate_sem_data(100, "ideal")
data <- generate_sem_advantage_data(n = 100)
model <- '
    x1 ~ 1
    x2 ~ 1
    x3 ~ 1
    x4 ~ x1 + x2 + x3
'

zero_fit <- sem(model, data = data, do.fit = FALSE)
free_params <- parTable(zero_fit)$est[parTable(zero_fit)$free > 0]
opt_result <- optim(
    par = free_params,
    fn = likelihood_sem,
    fit = zero_fit,
    data = data,
    x_names = x_names,
    y_names = y_names,
    method = "Nelder-Mead"
)

# Models
optimized_fit <- get_new_fit(opt_result$par, zero_fit)
lavaan_fit <- sem(model, data = data)
lm_model <- lm(x4 ~ x1 + x2 + x3, data = data)

# Compare MSE on test data
test_data <- generate_sem_data(1000, "ideal")
mse_lm <- calculate_mse(
    predict(lm_model, test_data),
    test_data$x4
)
mse_lavaan <- mse_sem(
    lavaan_fit,
    test_data,
    x_names,
    y_names
)
mse_optimized <- mse_sem(
    optimized_fit,
    test_data,
    x_names,
    y_names
)

lm_mse_lavaan <- calculate_mse(
    predict_lm(lavaan_fit, test_data, x_names, y_names),
    test_data$x4
)
lm_mse_optimized <- calculate_mse(
    predict_lm(optimized_fit, test_data, x_names, y_names),
    test_data$x4
)

actual_Y <- data[, y_names, drop = FALSE][, 1]
mse_lavaan_paper = mean((actual_Y - predicty.lavaan(lavaan_fit, test_data, c("x1", "x2", "x3"), c("x4")))^2)
mse_optimized_paper = mean((actual_Y - predicty.lavaan(optimized_fit, test_data, c("x1", "x2", "x3"), c("x4")))^2)

# print in a table
print(
    matrix(
        c(mse_lm, mse_lavaan, mse_optimized, lm_mse_lavaan, lm_mse_optimized, mse_lavaan_paper, mse_optimized_paper),
        nrow = 1,
        dimnames = list(NULL, c("LM", "Lavaan", "Optimized", "LM Lavaan", "LM Optimized", "mse_lavaan_paper", "mse_optimized_paper"))
    )
)
```

```{r}
get_model_specification <- function(scenario = "ideal") {
  if (scenario == "ideal" || scenario == "skewed") {
    return('
      latent1 =~ x1 + x2 + x3
      x4 ~ latent1
    ')
    
  } else if (scenario == "misspecified") {
    return('
      latent1 =~ x1 + x2 + x3
      latent2 =~ x4
      latent2 ~ latent1
      x4 ~ x1  # direct effect added
    ')
    
  } else if (scenario == "regression") {
    return('
      x4 ~ x1 + x2 + x3
    ')
    
  } else {
    stop("Unknown scenario.")
  }
}

test_prediction_methods <- function(
  data_generator = generate_sem_data,
  scenario = "ideal",
  n_train = 500,
  n_test = 1000,
  lavaan_model_string,
  x_names = c(1, 2, 3),
  y_names = c(4)
) {
  # --- TRAINING ---
  train_data <- data_generator(n_train, scenario)

  # 1. Fit vanilla SEM (ML-based)
  lavaan_fit <- sem(lavaan_model_string, data = train_data, meanstructure = TRUE)

  # 2. Fit baseline linear model
  formula_lm <- as.formula(paste(colnames(train_data)[y_names], "~", paste(colnames(train_data)[x_names], collapse = " + ")))
  lm_model <- lm(formula_lm, data = train_data)

  # 3. Fit optimized SEM (your custom method)
  zero_fit <- sem(lavaan_model_string, data = train_data, do.fit = FALSE)
  free_params <- parTable(zero_fit)$est[parTable(zero_fit)$free > 0]
  opt_result <- optim(
    par = free_params,
    fn = likelihood_sem,
    fit = zero_fit,
    data = train_data,
    x_names = x_names,
    y_names = y_names,
    method = "BFGS"
  )
  optimized_fit <- get_new_fit(opt_result$par, zero_fit)

  # --- TESTING ---
  test_data <- data_generator(n_test, scenario)

  # 4. Compute MSEs
  mse_lavaan <- mse_sem(lavaan_fit, test_data, x_names, y_names)
  mse_optimized <- mse_sem(optimized_fit, test_data, x_names, y_names)

  lm_mse_lavaan <- calculate_mse(
    predict_lm(lavaan_fit, test_data, x_names, y_names),
    test_data[[y_names]]
  )
  lm_mse_optimized <- calculate_mse(
    predict_lm(optimized_fit, test_data, x_names, y_names),
    test_data[[y_names]]
  )

  mse_lm <- calculate_mse(
    predict(lm_model, test_data),
    test_data[[y_names]]
  )

  # --- RESULTS ---
  results <- matrix(
    c(mse_lm, mse_lavaan, mse_optimized, lm_mse_lavaan, lm_mse_optimized),
    nrow = 1,
    dimnames = list(
      NULL,
      c("LM", "Lavaan (ML)", "SEM (Optimized)", "LM from Lavaan", "LM from Optimized")
    )
  )

  print(results)
  return(invisible(results))
}

model_string <- get_model_specification("ideal")

test_prediction_methods(
  data_generator = generate_sem_data,
  scenario = "ideal",
  n_train = 500,
  n_test = 1000,
  lavaan_model_string = model_string,
  x_names = c(1, 2, 3),
  y_names = c(4)
)
```
